title: Create project documentation and license
description:
Create LICENSE with standard MIT license text and README.md with comprehensive documentation. Document project mission, prerequisites (macOS arm64, Xcode/Metal, CMake, Odin), build commands, directory structure, low-level C bindings usage, high-level Odin generator usage (including streaming and stop sequences), MTP speculative decoding instructions, and release workflow details.

Acceptance Criteria:
- LICENSE file created containing valid MIT license
- README.md provides complete quickstart, build commands, and Odin API code examples
- Accurately details embedded Metal architecture and MTP speculative decoding
